entries.en: Interesting haunt, this Totentanz. Old factory, isn't it?
entries.ro: Loc interesant, Totentanz ăsta. Fabrică veche, nu?

entries.en: Likewise. But, hey, I can live with it.
entries.ro: La fel. Dar, hei, mă descurc.

entries.en: For now. But you try anything you shouldn't, I'll smash your skull 'gainst the wall. Got it?
entries.ro: Deocamdată. Dar dacă mai încerci ceva de-astea, îți sparg capul de perete. Pricepi?

entries.en: All clear. So, formalities all settled? Can we get to biz?
entries.en_m: All clear. So, formalities all settled, can we get to biz?
entries.ro: Clar. Deci, am rezolvat hârțogăraia? Hai să trecem la afaceri.

entries.en: What, no... no mood to small talk?
entries.en_m: What, no mood to small talk?
entries.ro: Ce, nu... n-ai chef de pălăvrăgeală?

entries.en: You need somethin'? Or you gonna keep fuckin' around?
entries.ro: Ce-ți trebuie? Sau continui să te prostești, pula mea?

entries.en: [Sit at bar] Could use a drink.
entries.ro: [Stai la bar] Mi-ar prinde bine o băutură.
